notes: Reduced grid interpolated linearly from the uploaded NetCDF file.
Original NetCDF axes: pitch [deg], wndSpd [m/s], rotSpd [rpm].
Exported JSON axes: pitch [rad], windSpeed [m/s], rotorSpeed [rad/s].
Cp, Ct and Cq are flattened in row-major order with index = iOmega*(nPitch*nWind) + iPitch*nWind + iWind.
For demo robustness, non-finite and negative interpolated Cp/Ct values were clamped to 0; Ct was capped at 2.5.
